english: One idea acts as a trigger that brings another idea to mind.

english: This cue brings another thought forward.
mapping_note: Cue as trigger marks Above/Cause.

english: This is the source idea that starts the next idea appearing.
mapping_note: Above/Cause as source trigger.

english: The second idea is what comes to mind after the trigger.
mapping_note: Below/Effect is the idea brought to mind.

english: After smelling bread, the memory of the grandmother's kitchen appears.
mapping_note: The memory is the effect idea brought to mind.

english: After the warning flag, the safety procedure is the retrieved content.
mapping_note: The retrieved procedure is the effect idea.

english: A new thought appears because of the cue.
mapping_note: The appearing thought is Below/Effect.

mapping_note: The memory is the idea brought by the trigger.
